access_level.description: The level to set, within the scope's `minimum` and `maximum` on access-control-defaults-get, or null to remove the rule.

id.description: Project id. If omitted, uses the active project.

resource.description: The scope: `project`, a tool name such as `dashboard` or `feature_flag`, or `property_definition`. The tool names are the keys of `resources` in access-control-roles-list.

resource_id.description: The object's id for a rule on one object (a pk, as returned by the object's own get tool), or the property definition id for a property rule. Null for the project or a whole tool.

role_id.description: The role id, as `role_id` in access-control-roles-list or `id` in roles-list.
